description: Source code for DHCPv4 configuration management, including functions for reading and modifying DHCP configuration files, setting network interface parameters, and retrieving DHCP server process ID and connected clients.

methods.name: CcspHalGetConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value from DHCP config file based on a key.

methods.name: CcspHalGetConfigLeaseValue
methods.description: Retrieves the lease time value from DHCP config file based on a key.

methods.name: CcspHal_change_config_value
methods.description: Modifies a specific configuration field in the DHCP config buffer.

methods.name: CcspHalSetDHCPConfigValues
methods.description: Updates DHCP configuration file with specified values and restarts DHCP services.

methods.name: CcspHalInterfacesetval
methods.description: Sets the IP address of a network interface.

methods.name: CcspHalNetmasksetvalue
methods.description: Sets the netmask of a network interface.

methods.name: CcspHalGetPIDbyName
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of a DHCP server by name.

methods.name: CcspHalNoofClientConnected
methods.description: Returns the number of connected client devices.

methods.name: checkLan
methods.description: Checks if LAN interface eth1 is active.
